title: Lepraria neglecta isolate:Allen 5258 Genome sequencing and assembly
description: The goal of this project was to determine the number of chromosomes in the L. neglecta genome and if it included the full compliment of genes at the mating type locus. Further details are included in the publication associated with this data entry: Chromosomal genome sequence assembly and mating type (MAT) locus characterization of the leprose asexual lichenized fungus Lepraria neglecta (Nyl.) Erichsen.
samples: MIGS Eukaryotic sample from Lepraria neglecta
USA: Washington State, Cheney, 330 meters southeast of the Cheney Wastewater Treatment Plant and 600 meters Northeast of the Columbia Plateau Trailhead
